title: DLA-RFI-CT-2027-WBOS-MKTRES
description: DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY (DLA) TROOP SUPPORT CLOTHING AND TEXTILES DIRECTORATE � PHILADELPHIA, PA REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) & SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE Whole-of-Government Web-Based Ordering System (WBOS) & Commercial eMarketplace Platform FEDERAL MARKET RESEARCH NOTICE (FAR 15.201(e) & FAR Part 10): This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for market research, planning, and information-gathering purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposals (RFP), Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO), or an obligation on the part of the Government to acquire any products or services. The Government is seeking broad industry input on commercial capabilities, architectural options, and market readiness. Responses are strictly voluntary; the Government will not reimburse any costs associated with preparing or submitting responses to this notice. 1. Executive Summary & Purpose of Inquiry The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Troop Support Clothing and Textiles (C&T) Directorate is conducting market research to explore commercial software solutions, digital eMarketplace architectures, and industry best practices for deploying a next-generation Web-Based Ordering System (WBOS). DLA�s Troop Support C&T organization serves as the Federal Government�s primary enterprise manager for military clothing and textiles, working extensively with domestic industry. DLA is currently assessing the expansion of this shared-services procurement model to serve civilian Whole-of-Government (WOG) partner agencies, including the Department of the Interior (DOI), Department of Justice (DOJ), Department of Transportation (DOT), Department of State (DOS), and Department of Homeland Security (DHS). The primary objective of this RFI is to engage commercial e-commerce developers, SaaS providers, systems integrators, and domestic textile industry stakeholders. DLA seeks to understand what commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) capabilities exist today, how commercial technology can resolve complex federal supply chain and fiscal integration challenges, and what industry recommendations DLA should incorporate into its upcoming acquisition strategy. DLA is committed to adopting commercial best practices and avoiding custom development wherever commercial platforms can satisfy or be adapted to meet mission requirements. 2. Administrative Overview & Acquisition Milestones Market Research Parameter: Information & Acquisition Guidance Document Identifier: DLA-RFI-CT-2027-WBOS-MKTRES Anticipated Acquisition Approach: Commercial Solutions Opening (10 U.S.C. � 3458) / Commercial Acquisition (FAR Part 12 / Agile Authorities) Primary NAICS Code: 541512 - Computer Systems Design Services (Small Business Size Standard: $34.0M) Secondary NAICS Codes: 518210 - Data Processing, Hosting, and Related Services ($40.0M), 541519 - Other Computer Related Services ($34.0M) Product Service Code (PSC): DA01 - IT and Telecom - Business Application/Application Development Software RFI Issuance Date: Friday, October 30, 2026 Industry Questions & Clarifications Due: Friday, November 06, 2026, at 16:00 EST Government Formal Q&A Responses Posted: Friday, November 20, 2026 RFI Capability Response Deadline: Friday, November 27, 2026, at 16:00 EST Anticipated Pre-Solicitation Industry Day: December 2, 2026 (Virtual) Primary Contract Specialist: Courtney Hunter, Contract Specialist, DLA Troop Support C&T (Courtney.Hunter@dla.mil) Primary Contracting Officer: Ryan Zarkowski, Individual Protection and Commercial Solutions Division Chief, DLA Troop Support (Ryan.Zarkowski@dla.mil) Submission Channel: Electronic submission via email to Government POCs (Subject: 'WBOS RFI Response - [Company Name]') 3. Mission Needs & Strategic Challenges The contemplated capability would enable Government-approved vendors to list and maintain Government-approved catalogs; enable authorized agency personnel to purchase authorized items; apply agency-specific eligibility, entitlement/allowance, item-authorization, approval, and management-control rules; support authorized payment methods; and provide auditable transaction, fulfillment, and program-management information. To modernize uniform procurement across DoD and civilian partner agencies, any future solution must address several interrelated operational and regulatory challenges. Rather than dictating prescriptive technical designs, DLA outlines the desired functional outcomes below to invite innovative, industry-driven solutions: Operational Domain: The Operational Challenge / Desired Outcome Commercial Marketplace & User Experience: Deliver a modern, consumer-grade multi-tenant e-commerce experience with sub-second catalog search, faceted filtering, mobile responsiveness, and intuitive uniform selection, while supporting distinct tenant agency branding (DoD, DOI, DOJ, DOT, DOS, DHS) and role-based permissions. Domestic Provenance & Supply Chain Integrity: Because DLA operates as a central procurement hub utilizing the Defense Working Capital Fund (DWCF), end-items transacted through DLA are subject to 100% domestic sourcing requirements under the Berry Amendment (10 U.S.C. � 4862). DLA requires automated mechanisms to verify domestic origin down to the raw material/mill level, screen supply chains for forced labor or prohibited foreign entities, and prevent unverified items from being purchased. Statutory Competition & Micro-Purchases: In a multi-vendor marketplace environment, transactions must respect federal competition mandates (such as CICA and simplified acquisition thresholds). The Government seeks automated, user-friendly marketplace workflows that promote fair competition, facilitate dynamic quoting between micro-purchase thresholds ($15k) and simplified acquisition threshold ($350k), and prevent improper order splitting without creating administrative bottlenecks. Uniform Customization & Value-Added Logistics: Civilian law enforcement and military personnel require customized uniforms (e.g., branch tapes, badges, department patches, embroidery, reflective safety trims, and tailored sizing). The system must support interactive customization, dimensionally accurate digital proofing, supervisor approvals, and tracking of value-added tailoring services while ensuring all component materials remain compliant. Interagency Accounting & Fiscal Guardrails: The system must handle interagency funding across diverse partner departments without risking Antideficiency Act (ADA) violations. This includes integrating with federal financial frameworks (such as Treasury G-Invoicing Form 7600A/B), managing annual individual officer uniform allowances (5 U.S.C. � 5901), supporting multi-payment split tender (allowance + GPC + personal card overages), and reconciling DLA cost-recovery surcharges without contractor fee retention. Cybersecurity & Enterprise Interoperability: The platform will process sensitive federal uniform requisitions, military supply chain data, and law enforcement personnel information. It must meet high federal cybersecurity baselines (such as FedRAMP and DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements), support CAC/PIV single sign-on, and interface with federal backbones such as DLA Enterprise Business System (EBS/SAP), PIEE/WAWF, and SAM.gov. Training & Performance Tracking: Provide general user training, program manager training, etc. Implement all necessary work and time management control processes to ensure timely accurate accomplishment of work requirements as well as to permit tracking work in progress. 4. Areas of Inquiry & Market Research Questionnaire Industry respondents are invited to address the following questions. Offerors may respond to all or selected inquiry areas based on their core competencies and commercial experience. 4.1 Pillar 1: Market Position & Differentiation Question 1.1 (Core Competencies): Outline your primary services and expertise, such as previous projects in a similar scope, or any COTS options you currently off

title: Program Analysis and Control (PAAC V) Bridge
description: NASA/GSFC intends to extend the period of performance for a period of six (6) months and increase the maximum ordering value of Contract 80GSFC25D0003, Program Analysis and Control (PAAC V) Bridge with ASRC Federal System Solutions (AFSS). The PAAC V Bridge contract provides accounting, planning and scheduling/earned value management, documentation management, configuration management and security compliance. The place of performance for PAAC V Bridge is the NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC) Facilities and Installations, NASA Headquarters (HQ), Langley Research Center, and other NASA Centers, as needed. NASA/GSFC intends to extend the ordering period for six (6) additional months from December 1, 2026, to May 31, 2027, and increase the maximum ordering value of the PAAC V Bridge contract to ensure uninterrupted support until the follow-on competitive contract is awarded and contract transition is completed. The proposed increase of $20.24M will revise the contract maximum ordering value from $180,000,000 to $200,240,000. This procurement action is being conducted on a sole source basis in accordance with FAR 6.302-1 and 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1). As the incumbent contractor, AFSS is uniquely qualified to provide the services required. AFSS is considered the only contractor that can meet GSFC�s needs, without disruption to current programs and services, given the short amount of time remaining under the current contract. These services function as integral parts of all the aforementioned NASA missions. The skills required to support such critical missions and milestones cannot be readily replaced. Award to any other source for this period would delay NASA/GSFC�s missions. The government does not intend to acquire a commercial item using FAR Part 12. This notice is not a request for competitive proposals. However, interested organizations may submit their capabilities and qualifications to perform the effort electronically via email to Cynthia White at Cynthia.L.White@nasa.gov no later than 4:30pm local time on November 27, 2026. Such capabilities/qualifications will be evaluated solely for the purpose of determining whether or not to conduct this procurement on a competitive basis. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed acquisition on a full and open competition basis, based on responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the government. Oral communications are not acceptable in response to this notice. NASA Clause 1852.215-84 Ombudsman is applicable. The Center Ombudsman for this acquisition can be found at https://www.hq.nasa.gov/office/procurement/regs/Procurement-Ombuds-Comp-Advocate-Listing.pdf

Διαγωνισμός: ΜΕΛΕΤΗ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ ΤΟΥ ΑΥΤΟΚΙΝΗΤΟΔΡΟΜΟΥ ΔΕΝΕΙΑΣ - ΑΚΑΚΙΟΥ - ΑΣΤΡΟΜΕΡΙΤΗ - ΚΠΣ/19/2025/ΜΚ(Α) Προβολή Μενού Διαγωνισμού Όνομα Αναθέτουσας Αρχής: Τμήμα Δημοσίων Έργων Τίτλος: ΜΕΛΕΤΗ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ ΤΟΥ ΑΥΤΟΚΙΝΗΤΟΔΡΟΜΟΥ ΔΕΝΕΙΑΣ - ΑΚΑΚΙΟΥ - ΑΣΤΡΟΜΕΡΙΤΗ - ΚΠΣ/19/2025/ΜΚ(Α) Μοναδικός Αριθμός Διαγωνισμού: ΚΠΣ/19/2025/ΜΚ(Α) Μηχανισμός Αξιολόγησης: Βάσει Τιμής/Κόστους Περιγραφή: Το έργο αφορά την πλήρη μελέτη και κατασκευή του Αυτοκινητόδρομου Δένειας – Ακακίου - Αστρομερίτη, 4 λωρίδων κυκλοφορίας, συνολικού μήκους περίπου 18 km. Θα συνδέει τον αυτοκινητόδρομο Λευκωσίας-Κοκκινοτριμιθιάς με τον αυτοκινητόδρομο Αστρομερίτη-Ευρύχου και θα διέρχεται νότια των χωριών Ακακίου, Περιστερώνας και Αστρομερίτη. Η τυπική διατομή περιλαμβάνει 4 λωρίδες κυκλοφορίας 3,5 μ έκαστη με κεντρική νησίδα και με ασφαλτοστρωμένα ερείσματα εκατέρωθεν, πλάτους 3,0 μ. Οι κατασκευαστικές εργασίες, μεταξύ άλλων περιλαμβάνουν 4 ανισόπεδους κόμβους, τη συμπλήρωση ενός υφιστάμενου ανισόπεδου κόμβου, χωματουργικές και ασφαλτικές εργασίες, εργασίες αποχέτευσης ομβρίων περιλαμβανομένων εργασιών κατασκευής κλειστού συστήματος απορροής ομβρίων οδοστρώματος, τροποποιήσεις υφιστάμενων Υπηρεσιών, εγκαταστάσεις νέων Υπηρεσιών, εγκατάσταση οδικού φωτισμού, κοιλαδογέφυρες, υπέργειες και υπόγειες διαβάσεις, ορθογωνικούς οχετούς και τοίχους αντιστήριξης. title: Finland – Guard services – Hälytysvalvonta- ja piirivartiointipalvelu 2027-2031 (2033)
description: Lahden kaupunki pyytää osallistumishakemuksia Hälytysvalvonta- ja piirivartiointipalvelujen hankintaan. Hankinnan kohteena ovat Lahden kaupungin ja Koulutuskeskus Salpauksen tarvitsemat vartiointipalvelut. Hankintaan sisältyy erilaisia vartiointi- ja turvallisuuspalveluja tilaajien tarpeiden mukaisesti. Hankinnan tarkempi sisältö, palveluille asetettavat vaatimukset sekä palvelukohteet kuvataan varsinaisen tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden yhteydessä. Hankinnan arvioitu kokonaisarvo on (sopimuskausi 4 vuotta, mahdollinen optiokausi 2 vuotta) noin 3 500 000 €. Hankinta toteutetaan kaksivaiheisena menettelynä. Ensimmäisessä vaiheessa ehdokkaat jättävät osallistumishakemuksensa. Osallistumishakemusten perusteella hankintayksikkö valitsee enintään neljä (4) ehdokasta, jotka kutsutaan menettelyn toiseen vaiheeseen jättämään tarjous. Ehdokkaiden tulee täyttää osallistumispyynnössä asetetut soveltuvuusvaatimukset. Mikäli soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttäviä ehdokkaita on enemmän kuin neljä (4), tarjousvaiheeseen kutsuttavat ehdokkaat valitaan osallistumispyynnössä ilmoitettujen vertailuperusteiden mukaisesti.

title: Bulgaria – Telescopic sights – „Доставка на оптически прибори, чрез сключване на рамкови споразумения по три самостоятелно обособени позиции“.
description: Предметът на обществената поръчка е „Доставка на оптически прибори, чрез сключване на рамкови споразумения по три самостоятелно обособени позиции“, както следва: Обособена позиция № 1 „Доставка на монокуляр за нощно виждане ”, съгласно ТС О 33.4578.24 – ВО; Обособена позиция № 2 „Доставка на нощен оптически мерник за стрелково оръжие“, съгласно ТС О 33.4579.24 – ВО; Обособена позиция № 3 „Доставка на дневен оптически мерник“, съгласно ТС О 33.4927.25 – ВО. Обществената поръчка не съдържа класифицирана информация по смисъла на § 2, т. 20 от Допълнителните разпоредби на ЗОП. Рамковите споразумения за всяка обособена позиция ще бъдат сключени с едно лице – участникът, класиран на първо място и определен за изпълнител по съответната обособена позиция. В Рамковите споразумения са определени всички условия и на основание чл. 82, ал. 1 от ЗОП, Възложителят ще сключва конкретни договори, като прилага тези условия. - По Обособена позиция № 1 „Доставка на монокуляр за нощно виждане ”, съгласно ТС О 33.4578.24 – ВО - общото прогнозно количество, което се предвижда да бъде доставено до 2960 броя, разпределена (прогнозно) по години за целия срок на действие на рамковото споразумение. - По Обособена позиция № 2 „Доставка на нощен оптически мерник за стрелково оръжие“, съгласно ТС О 33.4579.24 – ВО - общото прогнозно количество, което се предвижда да бъде доставено до 1228 броя, разпределена (прогнозно) по години за целия срок на действие на рамковото споразумение. - По Обособена позиция № 3 „Доставка на дневен оптически мерник“, съгласно ТС О 33.4927.25 – ВО - общото прогнозно количество, което се предвижда да бъде доставено е до 1439 броя, разпределена (прогнозно) по години за целия срок на действие на рамковото споразумение.

title: Greece – Hire of trucks with driver – ΜΙΣΘΩΣΗ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΓΙΑ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΣΜΟΥ ΣΕ ΠΟΤΑΜΟΥΣ ΚΑΙ ΡΕΜΑΤΑ ΑΡΜΟΔΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ Π.Ε. ΡΟΔΟΠΗΣ ΕΤΩΝ 2027-2028
description: Η παρούσα μελέτη αφορά την μίσθωση μηχανημάτων και φορτηγών, με την μορφή έξι (6) ομάδων, ως εξής: 1η ομάδα αποτελούμενη από έναν (1) ερπυστριοφόρο υδραυλικό εκσκαφέα (>120 ΗΡ) και ένα (1) φορτηγό ανατρεπόμενο, 2η ομάδα αποτελούμενη από έναν (1) ερπυστριοφόρο υδραυλικό εκσκαφέα (>120 ΗΡ) και ένα (1) φορτηγό ανατρεπόμενο, 3η ομάδα αποτελούμενη από έναν (1) ερπυστριοφόρο υδραυλικό εκσκαφέα (>50 ΗΡ έως 120 HP) και ένα (1) φορτηγό ανατρεπόμενο, 4η ομάδα αποτελούμενη από δύο (2) ερπυστριοφόρους υδραυλικούς εκσκαφείς (>120 ΗΡ) και δύο (2) φορτηγά ανατρεπόμενα, 5η ομάδα αποτελούμενη από δύο (2) ερπυστριοφόρους υδραυλικούς εκσκαφείς (>120 ΗΡ) και δύο (2) φορτηγά ανατρεπόμενα, 6η ομάδα αποτελούμενη από δύο (2) ερπυστριοφόρους υδραυλικούς εκσκαφείς (>120 ΗΡ) και δύο (2) φορτηγά ανατρεπόμενα. Συγκεκριμένα τα μισθωμένα μηχανήματα με τη μορφή ομάδων – συνεργείων, θα χρησιμοποιηθούν για τον καθαρισμό κοίτης και συγκεκριμένα την απομάκρυνση απορριμμάτων και μπαζών, για απομάκρυνση βλάστησης (καλαμιών, θάμνων, δέντρων), για άρση λοιπών εμποδίων (ξεροί κορμοί, κ.λπ.), για διαμόρφωση πρανών για την αποφυγή καταπτώσεων, για φόρτωση και μεταφορά προϊόντων καθαρισμού σε κατάλληλους χώρους καθώς και για τοπικές αποκαταστάσεις ζημιών σε αναχώματα. Οι ως άνω περιγραφόμενες εργασίες θα πραγματοποιηθούν με απώτερο σκοπό την ελεύθερη απορροή των υδάτων σε ρέματα, υδατορέματα, χειμάρρους και ποταμούς στα γεωγραφικά όρια της Περιφερειακής Ενότητας Ροδόπης, τα οποία θα υποδειχτούν από την Υπηρεσία μας και είναι συγκεκριμένα τα παρακάτω δεκαέξι (16) σημεία επέμβασης: Ρέμα Δυτικά Οικισμού Αμαξάδων, Ρέμα Ανατολικά Οικισμού Αμαξάδων ή Αμυγδαλόρεμα, Ρέμα Ασκητών, Ρέμα Βοσβόζη ή Ασπρόρεμα, Ρέμα Γλυφάδας 1, Ρέμα Γλυφάδας 2, Ρέμα Καλλυντηρίου, Ρέμα Μαυρομματίου 1, Ρέμα Μαυρομματίου 2, Ρέμα Παγουρίων, Ρέμα Πανεπιστημιούπολης, Ρέμα Παραδημής ή Χηνόρεμα, Ρέμα Πελαγίας, Ρέμα Πλατανίτη, Ρέμα Πλησίον Ηφαίστου, Ρέμα Φαναρίου. Οι ώρες εργασίας (διάρκεια μίσθωσης) της κάθε ομάδας είναι: ΟΜΑΔΑ ΩΡΕΣ ΜΙΣΘΩΣΗΣ 1η ΟΜΑΔΑ 1000 2η ΟΜΑΔΑ 1000 3η ΟΜΑΔΑ 1581,7672 4η ΟΜΑΔΑ 1000 5η ΟΜΑΔΑ 1300 6η ΟΜΑΔΑ 2000 Οι ώρες εργασίας του κάθε συνεργείου, υπολογίζονται ότι θα εξαντληθούν συνεχόμενα ή τμηματικά, σε χρονική διάρκεια είκοσι τεσσάρων (24) μηνών, όπως αναλυτικότερα περιγράφεται στη Τεχνική Περιγραφή και Προϋπολογισμό της παροχής υπηρεσίας, προϋπολογισμού 2.000.000,00 € συμπεριλαμβανομένου Φ.Π.Α.

description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η προμήθεια εξοπλισμού για τη ενίσχυση της πολιτικής προστασίας του Δήμου Δυτικής Σάμου στη λειτουργική βάση του μηχανισμού διαχείρισης κρίσεων και αντιμετώπισης φυσικών κινδύνων και συγκεκριμένα δύο ημιφορτηγών οχημάτων 4x4, τα οποία, αντίστοιχα, θα φέρουν πυροσβεστικό και εκχιονιστικό εξοπλισμό, ενός ανατρεπόμενου φορτηγού και ενός ερπυστριοφόρου εκσκαφέα. title: Presolicitation Notice for V-22/H-53 Forward Looking-Infrared Performance Based Logistics Requirements Contract.
description: NAVSUP Weapon Systems Support (NAVSUP WSS) Philadelphia plans to award a Performance Based Logistics (PBL) requirements contract in support of the Forward-looking Infrared (FLIR) on the V-22 aircraft and CH-53 helicopter. This requirement includes repair, replacement of assets, warehousing, issuance of assets in response to requisitions in accordance with availability requirements, supply chain management, configuration management, and obsolescence management. The Government intends to contract on a sole source basis with Raytheon Company (CAGE code 96214) located in McKinney, TX. The resultant PBL contract will include one 5-year base period and no option period. The contract will include PBL support of 12 NSNs which are listed in the attached document. Justification for Sole Source Acquisition is based upon the statutory authority of 10 U.S.C. � 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR 6.302-1, only one or a limited number of responsible sources and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. Absent interest/approval of additional sources, the Government intends to solicit Raytheon Company. Raytheon Company is the only source capable of providing integrated logistics support for the entire scope of necessary performance requirements related to repair, manufacturing, availability, engineering sustainment, obsolescence management, and required forecasting. NAVSUP WSS does not own rights to drawings. Drawings cannot be obtained, nor is it possible to draft adequate specifications for them to facilitate competition at this time. The subject items require Government source approval prior to contract award, as the items are flight critical and/or the technical data available has not been determined adequate to support repair via full and open competition. Only the Raytheon Company will be solicited. The time required for approval of a new source is normally such that an award cannot be delayed pending approval of a new source. If you are not an approved source you must submit, together with your proposal, the information detailed in the NAVSUP WSS Source Approval Information Brochure for repair. A Source Approval Request (SAR) brochure is available upon request. If your request for source approval is currently being evaluated at NAVSUP WSS submit with your offer a copy of the cover letter which forwarded your request for source approval. Offers received which fail to provide all data required by the Source Approval Brochure or document previous submission of all data required by the Source Approval Brochure will not be considered for award under this solicitation. Please note, if evaluation of a source approval request submitted hereunder cannot be processed in time and/or approval requirements preclude the ability to obtain subject items in time to meet Government requirements, award of the subject requirement may continue based on Fleet support needs. Based upon market research, the Government is not using the policies contained in FAR Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Items, in its solicitation for the described supplies or services. However, interested persons may identify to the contracting officer their interest and capability to satisfy the Government's requirement with a commercial item within 15 days of this notice. title: Automated Celestial Navigation System (ACNS) Production
description: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS. THIS SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE IS PUBLISHED FOR MARKET RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY. THE GOVERNMENT IS NOT SEEKING OR ACCEPTING UNSOLICITED PROPOSALS. This notice is a Request for Information (RFI) as defined in FAR 15.101(c). The Portfolio Acquisition Executive Mission Systems (PAE MS) is conducting market research for the Automated Celestial Navigation System (ACNS). ACNS helps to determine vessel position based on optical sighting of celestial objects including stars and resident space objects (RSOs) such as satellites and space debris. Ship�s position derived from ACNS shall be used to improve the resilience of the surface ship Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) system of systems suite by providing an Alternative Position Source (APS) to support Assured PNT. U.S. Navy and commercial enterprises leverage a variety of navigation solutions that allow vessels to safely navigate with and without GPS. The U.S. Navy is looking to modernize legacy systems over time. This RFI seeks information on prospective technologies that could be leveraged or developed as enablers for an ACNS solution. This RFI seeks to understand how interested parties would integrate the ACNS with navigation sensors and other ship equipment specifically Global Positioning System-Based Positioning, Navigation, and Timing Service (GPNTS). PAE MS invites all interested potential sources, including small business concerns, to submit written information sufficient to demonstrate the respondent�s ability to fulfill the requirements. For those interested parties that have technologies which may not achieve a Technology Readiness Level (TRL) of 8-9 by FY 2029, please provide information on current research and development efforts that may address some or all requirements of this RFI beyond FY 2029. Responses are requested by 27 November 2026. Questions or clarifications related to this RFI may be submitted electronically to Ms. Liz Bonilla-Sotomayor at liz.c.bonilla-sotomayor.civ@us.navy.mil and Ms. Andrea Longo at andrea.t.longo.civ@us.navy.mil. Verbal questions will not be accepted. Questions shall not contain classified information. Please ensure that the subject line of any emails containing responses or questions related to this notice includes the name of your firm and �Automated Celestial Navigation System (ACNS) RFI Response� (without quotation marks) in the subject line. Responses are limited to a maximum of fifteen (15) pages in length, excluding the cover page, within a minimum font size of 10 points. Generic capability statements that do not address the information requested in this RFI will be deemed non-responsive without any further communication from the Government. All responsive submissions received by the due date noted in this RFI may be considered by the Government to inform the resulting Request for Proposal. All information received bearing proprietary markings will be handled in accordance with applicable statutes and regulations. Responses to this notice will not be returned and will be maintained or destroyed in accordance with the Government�s records management policy. An acknowledgement of receipt will be provided for all responses received. If you do not receive an acknowledgement within two working days, please notify the points of contact listed in this notice. All materials submitted in response to this RFI should be UNCLASSIFIED. Provide Component Characteristics: 1) What is the current configuration of the proposed system? 2) Sensor volume and physical dimensions; 3) Sensor weight; 4) What environmental Military Standards does your proposed system meet (i.e. MIL-STD-810H CH1 (Environmental Engineering Considerations and Laboratory Tests), MIL-STD-167-1A (Mechanical Vibrations of Shipboard Equipment), MIL-DTL-901E (High-Impact Mechanical Shock for Shipboard Machinery and Equipment), and MIL-STD-461H (Electromagnetic Interference Characteristics of Subsystems and Equipment)? Additional Information: Anticipated development timeline if not currently in production; How the solution will be phased over time; Additional technologies that can be leveraged to support a robust ACNS solution; Sensors supported (e.g. radars, Electro-Optical/Infrared (EO/IR), Automatic Identification System (AIS), etc.); Interfaces supported (including physical and digital integration with GPNTS); Projected cost drivers or potential major cost drivers; Projected schedule drivers or potential major schedule drivers; Identification of relevant technology risk areas and any ongoing technology maturation initiatives currently under way; Information concerning your ability at conducting and supporting the full-range of current Model Based Systems Engineering � Digital Engineering (MBSE-DE) features to consider in a Contractor-Government partnership with a vision for balancing benefits of digital engineering collaboration against additional upfront and long-term costs and learning curves; The ability to build ACNS based on a government-provided Level III Technical Data Packages (TDPs) and other design specific documentation, if provided. Please identify any proprietary technology or information integral to your proposed solution that could potentially limit future Government production or sustainment efforts. Comment on your company�s willingness to provide Government Purpose Rights for any identified proprietary technology or information. In addition, recommend solutions or mitigation paths for the Navy to overcome the obstacles. This notice is not a request for proposals. Per FAR 15.101(c), responses to this notice do not constitute offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. title: Charter Vessel to Conduct a Longline Survey in the Eastern Bering Sea, Aleutian Islands Region, and Gulf of Alaska
description: This is a Sources Sought notice for a Charter Vessel to conduct a Longline Survey in the Eastern Bering Sea, the Aleutian Islands Region, and the Gulf of Alaska. THIS ANNOUNCEMENT IS NOT A SOLICITATION AND IS BEING USED FOR THE PURPOSE OF MARKET RESEARCH ONLY. Solicitations are not available at this time. Requests for a solicitation will not receive a response. This notice does not constitute a commitment by the United States Government. Respondents will not be entitled to payment of direct or indirect costs incurred in responding to this notice. In accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) 15.101(c), responses to this notice are not quotations and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. The attached draft Statement of Work (SOW) is for reference only; the final SOW may change. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), Acquisition and Grants Office (AGO), Western Acquisition Division (WAD), located in Seattle, WA, is conducting market research to assess the current and near-future marketplace and potential vendors capable of performing a Longline Survey for sablefish and other groundfish in the Eastern Bering Sea, the Aleutian Islands region, and the Gulf of Alaska for the NOAA Fisheries Alaska Fisheries Science Center (AFSC). Information provided in response to this notice will be used to assess tradeoffs and alternatives available to determine how to proceed in the acquisition process. This notice requests interested parties to describe their technical capabilities and demonstrated facilities, processes, and service capabilities. All interested contractors are requested to provide written responses to the questions below. Responding to this notice is necessary to assist NOAA Fisheries in determining the potential levels of interest, adequacy of competition, market maturity, and technical capabilities within the business community to provide the required capabilities. The Government is seeking industry input to determine the feasibility of this charter and the availability of qualified sources with the technical capability to fulfill the requirements outlined in the draft SOW. The Government welcomes industry comments, questions, and suggestions that will aid it in understanding industry capabilities, developing its acquisition strategy, and finalizing the SOW. The purpose of this Sources Sought notice is threefold: To determine the capability, interest, and availability of vendors in the marketplace; For vendors to provide input on compensation structures and cost-recovery arrangements (e.g., daily sea-day and fuel rates offset by catch sales) that ensure contractors are adequately compensated; and To encourage vendor/Government dialog that allows exploration of alternative approaches that may reduce cost and operational risk. If a solicitation is generated by the Government from this notice, the Government reserves the right to use all of the information, use none of the information, or change all or part of the information noted and contained in the attached draft SOW. The Government may utilize the information provided to refine its acquisition strategy to maximize competition among viable alternatives. This notice is being published in accordance with RFO 10.001(b), which requires conducting market research before soliciting quotations for acquisitions with an estimated value in excess of the Simplified Acquisition Threshold. The Government does not intend to disclose vendor proprietary information or trade secrets to the public. However, the Government may use the information submitted by vendors during the market research period in preparing its solicitation and finalizing the SOW, provided this can be done without disclosing proprietary vendor information protected from disclosure pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) and other laws and regulations. Responses to this Sources Sought notice are due to the Contracting Officer and Contract Specialist. Contact information is as follows: Contracting Officer: Carina Topasna, Carina.Topasna@noaa.gov Contract Specialist: Novelle Key, Novelle.Key@noaa.gov Responses must be submitted via email to the above individuals no later than November 27, 2026 at 2:00 PM Pacific Time. A Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) is requested with your submission. Registration in the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) is not necessary to respond to this notice. If the information in this notice leads to a solicitation, registration in SAM.gov will be a requirement for doing business with and entering into a contract with the Government. All questions regarding this procurement should be sent via email to the Contracting Officer and Contract Specialist. If appropriate, an amendment will be posted to provide relevant questions and answers to all interested vendors. This Sources Sought notice is being issued under NAICS: 483114. All interested prospective firms are invited to respond. A determination from this notice may lead to a small business set-aside in accordance with RFO Part 19 if this notice results in a future solicitation. All prospective firms who respond to this notice will be contacted if/when a solicitation is posted to SAM.gov. Cost Recovery and Compensation Mechanism: Under the updated 2027�2031 SOW model, the vessel cleans, processes, and freezes all commercially marketable catch not retained for biological sampling to standards that ensure the highest revenues. Catch is sold by the Contractor within three months of the final day of fishing. Rather than the historical threshold-retention model, the contract utilizes a cost-offset structure: Revenue generated from the sale of retained catch is credited and deducted from the total charter reimbursement cost. The Contractor invoices for Sea Days and fuel following Government review and approval of the mandatory Post-Survey Sales Report. After the first cruise leg, the Contractor provides actual fuel consumption, catch data, and cost-recovery projections; if revenues or agency funding fluctuate, the Government maintains the option to adjust remaining survey days to keep the contract within available funds. SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS (CAPABILITIES STATEMENT) Prospective firms should notify the Contracting Officer and Contract Specialist of their interest by submitting a Capabilities Statement that includes their company size, descriptive literature/vessel specifications, and responses to the following items: A statement confirming your firm has the capability to meet the requirements and perform the services outlined in the draft SOW. Your firm's Unique Entity Identifier (UEI). Your firm�s Small Business Administration (SBA) certified status. A brief description of your firm�s recent past experience (within the past three years) performing relevant work. Suggestions or comments regarding the proposed cost-recovery offset model so contractors do not operate at a loss. Suggestions for alternative survey arrangements that increase operational efficiency or decrease operating costs. Specifically, are there modifications to the draft SOW that would increase your firm's interest in submitting a quotation? A Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) estimate and commentary regarding key cost drivers that should be considered for the attached SOW. All information received in response to this notice shall be treated as Business Sensitive or confidential to the responder, exempt from public release under FOIA.

title: Roof Snow Block
description: This acquisition is a new requirement for the procurement of an engineered, continuous pipe or fence-style rail snow retention system for facility roof installation. System Configuration: Must be a continuous horizontal pipe- or fence-style rail snow retention system capable of bridging across structural roof panels and providing continuous longitudinal perimeter retention. Retention Capacity & Coverage: System must furnish 720 linear feet of continuous perimeter retention coverage. Substrate Compatibility: Mounting clamps and hardware must be fully compatible with the host metal roofing profile (e.g., standing seam or exposed fastener). Attachment systems for standing-seam profiles must utilize non-penetrating clamping mechanisms to preserve the weather-tight integrity and manufacturer warranty of the roof panels. Structural Performance Thresholds: System components (brackets, clamps, rails, and fasteners) must be engineered and rated to resist site-specific snowpack and ice accumulation shear loads without permanent mechanical deflection. Clamp-to-seam holding strength must meet or exceed minimum structural thresholds (e.g., capable of sustaining design loads up to 500 lbs per clamp or linear foot minimum, adjusted to site-specific engineering design calculations). Fastening hardware must utilize round-point or non-cutting setscrew designs (e.g., 300-series stainless steel per ASTM F880) to prevent piercing, galling, or compromising protective coatings on metal roof seams.

title: Maintenance, Repair, and Preservation of 60DS1701
description: The Regional Maintenance Center at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS & IMF) is conducting market research to determine industry capability and interest in performing the maintenance, repair, and preservation in support of one (1) Dive Boat 60DS1701. Work will be accomplished at the Contractor's facility. The Government is seeking responses from sources that can perform the following work. Geographical Area of consideration: To facilitate proper government oversight, the facility shall be located in the Puget Sound, WA region. For this procurement, the Puget Sound, WA region is defined as the West Coast of the continental US, starting from Olympia, WA and extending northward to Bellingham, WA. 60DS1701 � Length: 65.4 FT � Width: 22 FT � Age: 10 YRS � Hull Type: Aluminum � Draft: 3.5 FT � Full Displacement: 48.05 L Tons � Light Load: 8000 LBS Scope Overview: Coordinate with the Contracting Officer, via the Contracting Officer�s Representative (COR) to deliver the vessel to the Contractor�s facility. Upon docking the vessel; wash and clean the exterior surfaces of the vessel. Remove Rubber Fenders. Replace Zinc Anodes. Hull Blasting and Preservation. Hull and Freeboard Visual Inspection. Hull and Freeboard Ultrasonic Test Inspection. Repair D-Fender Corrosion. Inspect Quick Acting Watertight Doors. Open, Pump, Clean, Ventilate, and Gas Free Tanks/Voids, Including Freshwater System. Tank/Void Visual Inspection Gunnel Repair. Main Propulsion and Steering Repairs. Main Cabin and Interior Spaces Deck Preservation. Replace bent brow bracket. Forward Push Bar Repair. Main Engine and SSDG 5K/10K Maintenance. Perform sea trials after completion of repairs and full cure time of preservation. Undock the vessel. Arrange and coordinate the delivery of the vessel back to the Government with the COR. 60DS1701 Availability: Estimated July 2027 through September 2027 What/Where to Submit: Interested companies should submit, on company letterhead, a notice of interest including the name, telephone number, mailing address, and e-mail address of one point of contact. Please hand or digitally sign your letter of interest and e-mail it to the Government contacts listed below, with " Maintenance, Repair, and Preservation of 60DS1701 Sources Sought Response" in the subject field. The notice of interest should include a brief description of your company and its capabilities as they relate to the requirements set forth in the description shown above, and answers to the following specific questions. Please limit your response to no more than 5 pages. 1. Is your company a small or large business as defined by the Small Business Administration (SBA) under NAICS code 336611 (a small business must have 1,300 or less employees)? 2. Does your company have a satisfactory performance record for the type of work required? Please provide examples of relevant and recent (within three years) past performance. 3. Does your company have the necessary organization, experience, accounting and operational controls, and technical skills, or the ability to obtain them (including, as appropriate, such elements as production control procedures, property control systems, quality assurance measures, and safety programs applicable to materials to be produced or services to be performed by the prospective contractor and subcontractors)? 4. Does your company have a current Agreement for Boat Repair (ABR) or Master Ship Repair Agreement (MSRA) issued by Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA)? 5. Given the work described in this announcement, does your company plan to submit a quotation in response to the anticipated solicitation for the Maintenance, Repair, and Preservation of 60DS1701 package? When to Submit: Responses are requested no later than 2:00PM PT, on 27 November 2026. Offered space must meet Government requirements for fire safety, accessibility, seismic, and sustainability standards per the terms of the Lease. A fully serviced lease is required. Offered space shall not be in the 1-percent-annual chance floodplain (formerly referred to as �100-year� floodplain). Entities are advised to familiarize themselves with the telecommunications prohibitions outlined under Section 889 of the FY19 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), as implemented by the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR). The U.S. Government currently occupies office and related space in a building under a lease in Holtsville, NY, that will be expiring. The Government is considering alternative space if economically advantageous. In making this determination, the Government will consider, among other things, the availability of alternative space that potentially can satisfy the Government�s requirements, as well as costs likely to be incurred through relocating, such as physical move costs, replication of tenant improvements and telecommunication infrastructure, and non-productive agency downtime. title: NLS DTBM Breath Switch
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation in accordance with FAR Part 13. This is a simplified acquisition to establish a contract for a breath switch. This breath switch will be used to control the Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) DS-1 (Digital Standard version 1), DA-1 (Digital Advanced player version 1), and DA-2 (Digital Advanced player version 2) allowing for control of the device using pulses of air. The contractor shall develop both a breath switch and a Technical Data Package upon which this device is based. The breath switch shall consist of a micro controller and associated circuitry, a USB-A connector, housing, and a mouth tube. A full description of breath switch requirements is contained in Attachment J-3. The breath switch�s tubing shall be food safe (i.e., silicone). The contractor shall develop any required tooling, production/test equipment, and procedures required to manufacture the breath switch. This work shall comprise two phases: (1) a non-recurring engineering (NRE) phase and (2) a full-production phase. This is intended to be a single-award 5-year IDIQ above the simplified acquisition threshold. Please see the attached solicitation and associated attachments for more details. Amendment 030ADV27R0008 -0001 answers Offeror questions and extends the due date. Please see attached amendment 030ADV27R0008 -0001, revised Attachment J-2, and new Attachment J-5 for more details.

title: Denmark – Tents – Genudbud af Rammeaftale vedrørende teltservice
description: Udbuddet omfatter en rammeaftale om leje af teltservice til brug for arrangementer, øvelser og events, som afvikles af Ordregiver (”Rammeaftalen”). Rammeaftalen har til formål at dække ETKs løbende behov for leje af telte og tilhørende faciliteter til Forsvarsministeriets og underliggende myndigheders etablissementer. Rammeaftalen omfatter levering af den udbudte ydelse til Ordregivers lokationer i hele Danmark, inkl. ikke-brofaste øer. Der forventes dog alene et mindre behov for levering af ydelser til ikke-brofaste øer. Rammeaftalen indgås for en 4-årig periode, og den anslåede årlige værdi udgør 35.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms – det vil sige samlet 140.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms. Rammeaftalens maksimale værdi udgør 280.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms. Rammeaftalen omfatter leje af Teltservice inklusive følgende ydelser: • Telte til events og sanitære faciliteter • Telte til indkvartering og sanitære faciliteter • Materiale (enkeltvarer), herunder (ikke udtømmende): o Kontor- og beboelsesvogne o Køle- og frysecontainere til opbevaring af mad o Teknisk udstyr (hegn, lys, varme/køl, strøm, kabler, mv.) Rammeaftalen indgås med to leverandører. Opgaver, der tildeles på grundlag af Rammeaftalen, tildeles direkte på de vilkår, der er fastsat i Rammeaftalen, herunder de aftalte priser og øvrige kontraktvilkår. Som udgangspunkt tildeles alle opgaver til 1. prioritetsleverandøren. 2. prioritetsleverandøren tildeles alene en opgave i de i Rammeaftalens pkt. 8 angivne situationer.

title: Spain – Hotel accommodation services – concesión del servicio de explotación del Hotel Oromana (C-2026/032)
description: El objeto del presente contrato es la concesión del servicio de explotación del Hotel Oromana, de titularidad municipal, situado en el municipio de Alcalá de Guadaíra, que comprende la gestión integral del establecimiento, así como la ejecución de las actuaciones necesarias de rehabilitación, reforma, posible ampliación y adecuación del inmueble para su correcto funcionamiento y mejora de categoría, todo ello conforme a lo establecido en el correspondiente pliego de prescripciones técnicas. La presente contratación tiene como finalidad la transformación integral del establecimiento hotelero, con el objetivo de su adecuación a los estándares actuales del sector y su posicionamiento como hotel de cuatro estrellas, mediante la ejecución de las actuaciones constructivas necesarias y la implantación de un modelo de gestión profesionalizado, eficiente y orientado a la calidad. No se pretende con esta licitación una mera explotación del establecimiento en su estado actual, sino la definición y desarrollo de un proyecto global y coherente que integre la intervención sobre el inmueble con un modelo de gestión hotelera alineado con el valor patrimonial, paisajístico y turístico del entorno en el que se inserta, contribuyendo a reforzar la identidad y singularidad del destino. En este sentido, la concesión deberá orientarse a la creación de una oferta hotelera de calidad, capaz de atraer tanto a visitantes como a usuarios locales, generando actividad económica, empleo y sinergias con otros sectores vinculados al turismo, la cultura y la hostelería, y actuando como elemento dinamizador del municipio y su entorno. Asimismo, el contrato comprende tanto la ejecución de las obras definidas como obligatorias, como, en su caso, la incorporación de mejoras propuestas por los licitadores, así como la gestión integral del establecimiento, incluyendo todos los servicios necesarios para su correcto funcionamiento. El detalle y alcance de todas estas prestaciones se desarrollan en el pliego de prescripciones técnicas que rige la presente contratación.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Stadtwerke Frankenthal GmbH: Vergabe von Leistungen der Objektplanung für Ingenieurbauwerke für die Errichtung eines Wärmenetzes in Frankenthal (Los 1)
description: Die Stadtwerke Frankenthal GmbH ist ein kommunales Energieversorgungsunternehmen mit Sitz in Frankenthal (Pfalz). Sie versorgt die Stadt Frankenthal sowie angrenzende Gemeinden im Rhein-Pfalz-Kreis. Der derzeitige Versorgungsschwerpunkt liegt auf der Gasversorgung. Im Zuge der Energiewende soll diese schrittweise durch ein modernes Fernwärmenetz ersetzt werden. Im Rahmen der Bundesförderung für effiziente Wärmenetze, Modul 1, wurde hierfür eine Machbarkeitsstudie erstellt. Auf Grundlage dieser Studie wurde das östliche Stadtgebiet als erstes Ausbaugebiet von insgesamt zwei Ausbaugebieten zum Wärmenetzausbau festgelegt. Das erste Ausbaugebiet umschließt den Wärmenetzausbau bis 2032 und das zweite Ausbaugebiet umschließt den Wärmenetzausbau bis 2045. Das zweite Ausbaugebiet dient ausschließlich als langfristiger Ziel- und Betrachtungsraum für den Netzausbau bis 2045. Die konkrete Umsetzung ist nicht Gegenstand der ausgeschriebenen Planungsleistungen und kann auf Grundlage der Planungsergebnisse in mehrere Teilgebiete und Ausbaustufen untergliedert werden. Das vorliegende Vergabeverfahren bezieht sich auf den flächendeckenden Ausbau des Wärmenetzes für das erste Ausbaugebiet. Im ersten Ausbaugebiet soll ein Wärmenetz errichtet werden, das seine Wärme aus einer vorgelagerten Wärmeerzeugung bezieht. Der Übergabepunkt zum Vorlieferanten soll hydraulisch entkoppelt und ausschließlich über einen Wärmetauscher thermisch mit der Transportleitung des Wärmevorlieferanten gekoppelt werden. Es handelt sich insgesamt um zwei Übergabepunkte bzw. -stationen die sich einmal nord- und südöstlich außerhalb der Stadtgrenzen befinden. Für das Wärmenetz ist vorgesehen, dass es im Endausbau im Zieljahr 2045 einen jährlichen Wärmeabsatz von etwa 100 GWh erreicht. Die ausgeschriebene Planungsleistung umfasst zunächst den flächendeckenden Wärmenetzausbau im östlichen Stadtgebiet bis zum Jahr 2032 (erstes Ausbaugebiet). Der angestrebte Wärmeabsatz im Endausbau soll anschließend über das zweite Ausbaugebiet bis zum Jahr 2045 erreicht werden. Die Stadtwerke Frankenthal GmbH beabsichtigen, Planungsleistungen für die Errichtung des Wärmenetzes zu vergeben. Für die zu vergebenden Planungsleistungen bis einschließlich Leistungsphase 4 HOAI wurde ein BEW-Modul 1-Förderantrag gestellt. Für die darauf aufbauenden Planungsleistungen wird voraussichtlich ein BEW-Modul 2-Förderantrag gestellt werden.

title: Germany – Heating, ventilation and air-conditioning installation work – Anlagenbau Kompressionswärmepumpe
description: Der Auftraggeber erweitert seine Heizzentrale am Hartmut-Hermann-Weg 4 in 85716 Unterschleißheim. In der bestehenden Heizzentrale sind drei fossile Feuerungsanlagen mit einer Feuerungsleistung von jeweils unter 10 MW sowie drei Geothermie-Wärmetauscher vorhanden. Die Erweiterung ist mit vier Kompressionswärmepumpen mit einer Gesamtheizleistung von 10 MW und einer fossilen Feuerungsanlage mit unter 10 MW geplant. Folgende weitere Großkomponenten sind zu installieren: • Schallschutzkapsel zur Integration der Wärmepumpen in die Heizzentrale • Integration des bestehenden Heizkessels in Containerausführung in die Heizzentrale • Erneuerung der drei bestehenden Geothermiewärmetauscher • Erneuerung der Druckhaltung des Fernwärmenetzes • Erneuerung des Ölförderaggregats In der Heizungstechnik sind Rohrleitungen mit Formstücken aus geschweißtem Stahlrohr PN 16 sowie Pumpen und Armaturen bis zu einer Dimension von DN 300, Abgasleitungen aus Edelstahl bis zu einer Dimension von DN 800, Gasleitungen aus geschweißtem Stahlrohr bis zu einer Dimension von DN 150 und Ölleitungen aus geschweißtem Stahlrohr bis zu einer Dimension von DN 50 zu installieren. Die wärmeführenden Leitungen sind mittels Mineralfaserdämmung mit Blechmantel zu isolieren. In der Kältetechnik sind Kältemittelleitungen sowie Außen- und Inneneinheiten mit einer Gesamtleistung von ca. 100 kW zu installieren. In der Lüftungstechnik sind Wetterschutzgitter zur Verbrennungsluftnachströmung sowie Entwärmungs- und Belüftungsventilatoren mit einer maximalen Luftmenge von 20.000 m³/h zu installieren. Elektrotechnisch ist eine neue Trafoanlage (2.000 kVA) mit entsprechenden Installationen zu den Hauptabnehmern, den Kompressionswärmepumpen, und mit Kabeln bis 300 mm² vorgesehen. Ebenso ist eine Mittelspannungsanlage zu installieren. Weitere Niederspannungsabnehmer, wie vor allem heizungs- und kältetechnische Verbraucher, sind über eine Niederspannungshauptversorgung zu versorgen. Regelungstechnisch ist die bestehende Leitstation zu erweitern, Komponenten sind zu integrieren sowie neue regelungstechnische Anlagen aufzubauen.

description: In der Bundesanstalt für Gewässerkunde (BfG) soll ein neues Hochleistungsflüssikeitschromatographiesystem mit hochauflösenden Massenspektrometer und vorgeschaltetem Quadrupol Massenfilter (HPLC-HRMS/MS) und Elektrospray-Ionisation beschafft werden.
